item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Two Days Out: Weigh-Ins Tomorrow Morning, Ceremonial Faceoffs Stream Live Wednesday Evening
    Official weigh-ins for UFC BJJ 2 take place Wednesday morning (July 30) at the UFC Apex, with ceremonial faceoffs streaming live Wednesday evening on UFC YouTube; all 10 bouts are confirmed — Andrew Tackett defends the welterweight title against Renato Canuto in the main event, Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo crowns the inaugural light heavyweight champion in the co-main, and a family subplot sees Tackett's brother and Canuto's wife both debuting on the undercard.
    Source: UFC
  • ADCC Krakow 44 Days Out: Elite Camps Deep in Session; Galvao's Reinstatement Makes 77kg the Division to Watch
    With 44 days until ADCC 2026 (September 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), top grapplers including Kaynan Duarte, Yuri Simoes, and the reinstated Mica Galvao are in intensive training camp; Galvao's return reshapes an already stacked 77kg bracket, making it arguably the most anticipated division at the $362,000 prize-pool world championship alongside the Duarte-Simoes absolute superfight.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix August 20: Fornarino vs. Brunacio Headline Inaugural Bracket
    With UFC BJJ 2 days away, eyes are already turning to UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex): ADCC double-champion Adele Fornarino — who chose this event over ADCC Krakow — faces Brazilian standout Carol Brunacio in the semifinals of the first-ever UFC BJJ Women's Flyweight Grand Prix, a four-woman bracket that will crown the series' inaugural women's flyweight champion.
    Source: Jits Magazine

Global & European Soccer

  • PSG Preparing €164M Formal Offer for Alvarez as Atletico-PSG Transfer Alignment Hardens
    Multiple transfer sources report PSG is finalizing a formal €164M bid for Julian Alvarez, with Atletico Madrid steering the deal toward Paris rather than Barcelona; Spanish analyst Martin Otin claims Alvarez has already decided on PSG, while the player himself publicly refuses to rule out a future move — the formal offer's arrival could force a resolution before La Liga opens August 16.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • Atletico vs. Manchester United Saturday in Stockholm — Full Squad Ready for Simeone's First Complete Pre-Season Test
    Three days from Atletico Madrid's August 1 Stockholm friendly at Strawberry Arena (3pm CET), Diego Simeone has his complete squad at Majadahonda for the first time — all World Cup returnees integrated alongside summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in — making this the most important training week of the pre-season ahead of the La Liga title-defense opener away at Espanyol on August 16.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • Sorloth-Juventus: Nico Gonzalez Swap Tabled as Clubs Attempt to Bridge the Fee Gap
    Into the Calderon reports Juventus have proposed including midfielder Nico Gonzalez in a player-plus-cash arrangement to bridge Atletico's €35-40M asking price and Juventus's reluctance to exceed €30M fixed; with personal terms long since agreed between Sorloth and Juventus, the Gonzalez swap is the latest attempt to unlock a deal stalled for weeks.
    Source: Into the Calderon

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Fed Holds at 3.5-3.75% — Warsh Signals Inflation Vigilance at Press Conference, September Hike Odds Rise
    The FOMC voted to hold the federal funds rate at 3.5-3.75% today (July 29), the fifth consecutive hold; Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced his hawkish stance at the 2:30pm ET press conference with zero tolerance rhetoric for persistent inflation — markets responded by pushing September hike probability higher, a headwind for NJ homeowners hoping for mortgage rate relief before fall.
    Source: France24
  • Meta and Microsoft Report Tonight After Close — $60B META Quarter, Azure Growth, AI Capex Scale in Focus
    Meta Platforms ($7.21 EPS, $60.22B revenue consensus, +27% YoY) and Microsoft ($4.22 EPS, $87.5B revenue, Azure 40-42% growth expected) both report Q2/Q4 FY2026 results after today's close; investors are focused on $125-145B in Meta capex commitments and Copilot commercialization at Microsoft — paired beats or misses will directly set sentiment for Apple's report tomorrow and Spotify's August 4 call.
    Source: TipRanks
  • AAPL Earnings Tomorrow: Cook's Final Call as CEO, $1.89 EPS Consensus, iPhone 18 Pricing Signals Expected
    Apple reports Q3 FY2026 earnings after tomorrow's close (5pm ET) in Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes over as CEO; consensus projects $1.89 EPS on $108.8-110B revenue (+14-17% YoY), with key focus on services growth, AI narrative, and iPhone 18 Pro pricing — analysts suggest a ~$270 premium over the iPhone 17 Pro may be needed to sustain ~47% gross margins amid a global chip shortage.
    Source: Yahoo Finance

NJ Local News

  • Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival This Weekend — Dusk Balloon Launches Aug 1-2
    The 2026 Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival runs August 1-2 at the Warren County Fairgrounds in Harmony Township (~1 hour from Montclair), featuring agricultural exhibits, carnival rides, live music, local food, and the signature event: hot air balloon launches at dusk Saturday and Sunday — one of NJ's most distinctive summer family traditions.
    Source: NJ Family
  • MM by Morimoto Opens TOMORROW (July 31) in Montclair — Tonight Is Last Chance to Book on Resy
    Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's eagerly awaited MM by Morimoto opens its doors tomorrow (Thursday, July 31) at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair, with exclusive fish from Japan, A5 Wagyu beef, and a custom omakase bar — book tonight on Resy to lock in opening-week tables before they're gone; Pig & Butter (401 Orange Rd) also opens tomorrow with its ribbon-cutting at 10am.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Six Flags Great Adventure Boardwalk Nights: Final Weekend Aug 1-2 — Extended Hours, Full Thrills
    This weekend (August 1-2) is the last Boardwalk Nights event at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, NJ (~50 minutes from Montclair), with extended park hours, special entertainment, and full access to all rides — a strong option for families with a 12-year-old looking for a high-energy late-summer outing before the series wraps for 2026.
    Source: NJ Family

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Three Days Out: Tackett Eyes Series History as Fighters Arrive in Las Vegas
    Andrew Tackett heads to the UFC Apex for Thursday's free YouTube stream (8pm ET) with the chance to become the UFC BJJ series' first-ever title defender — no champion has successfully defended since the series launched in January 2026 — while Mason Fowler and David Garmo contest the inaugural light heavyweight title in the co-main.
    Source: UFC
  • FloGrappling Bulletin: IBJJF Worlds Delivers Memorable Performances — Gi Season Closes, No-Gi Takes Over
    FloGrappling's latest Grappling Bulletin declares IBJJF Worlds an 'incredible event' with standout performances across divisions; with the gi season now complete, elite attention shifts entirely to UFC BJJ 2 this Thursday and ADCC Krakow (September 12-13, 46 days away).
    Source: FloGrappling
  • July 2026 BJJ Rankings: Duarte-Simões Lead Absolute, Crevar's 21-Win Streak Tops Women's -60kg
    Jits Magazine's July rankings update reflects the settled post-trials landscape: Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simões sit atop the absolute rankings ahead of their ADCC Krakow superfight, while Helena Crevar's 21-consecutive-submission streak makes her the overwhelming women's -60kg favorite heading into September.
    Source: Jits Magazine

Global & European Soccer

  • Full Squad at Majadahonda: All 13 World Cup Players Arrive — Simeone Has Complete Group 4 Days Before Stockholm
    Atletico Madrid's complete squad — Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill alongside Argentine finalists Álvarez, Almada, G. Simeone, and Molina — is assembled at Majadahonda for the first time this pre-season today (July 28), giving Diego Simeone four full group sessions before the August 1 Stockholm friendly against Manchester United.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • PSG Now Third Club Chasing Álvarez — Argentine Committed for Now but Won't Rule Out Future Move
    Paris Saint-Germain have entered formal dialogue about Julián Álvarez, joining Arsenal (Gyokeres swap) and blocked Barcelona in the race for the Argentine World Cup finalist; Álvarez publicly remains committed to Atletico's La Liga title defense but has stopped short of ruling out a future move to PSG or Barcelona.
    Source: ESPN
  • Sørloth Impasse: Atletico and Juventus Still €5-10M Apart as Pre-Season Opens With No Deal Imminent
    Alexander Sørloth's move to Juventus remains unresolved as Atletico's pre-season begins in earnest: the clubs are stuck €5-10M apart (Atletico at €35-40M, Juventus around €25-30M plus bonuses) with personal terms agreed but the fee gap delaying Atletico's ability to reinvest funds from the sale.
    Source: Yahoo Sports

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • AAPL Sets All-Time High $339.57 — Surpasses Nvidia as World's Most Valuable Company at $4.96T, 2 Days to Earnings
    Apple shares hit a record $339.57 on Monday (July 27), pushing market cap to $4.96T and retaking the world's most valuable company title from Nvidia; the next milestone is $5T — achievable with a roughly 1% further gain — and Thursday's Q3 earnings call ($1.89 EPS consensus, $108.8B revenue) marks Tim Cook's final appearance as CEO before John Ternus takes over.
    Source: MacDailyNews
  • FOMC Opens 2-Day Meeting Today — Rate Hold Expected Tomorrow, 82% September Hike Odds; Meta and Microsoft Report After Bell
    The FOMC begins its July 28-29 meeting today with the federal funds rate at 3.50-3.75%; markets price a 65% probability of no change on Wednesday, but September rate hike odds have climbed to 82% — the decision arrives at 2pm ET Wednesday followed by Meta and Microsoft earnings after bell, then Apple and Amazon Thursday.
    Source: TradingKey
  • NJ 30-Year Refinance Edges Up to 6.87% Ahead of FOMC — SPOT at $495 With 7 Days to August 4 Report
    New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate ticked up to ~6.87% (from 6.70% last week) as FOMC uncertainty and residual oil pressure keep bond yields elevated; a hawkish Wednesday statement could push rates back toward 7%, while Spotify (SPOT, near $495) enters the final week before August 4 Q2 earnings with $3.29 EPS consensus — a 785% YoY jump — and operating income as the key re-rating catalyst.
    Source: NerdWallet

NJ Local News

  • Montclair Film Announces Free Zootopia 2 Outdoor Screening — August 29 at Brookdale Park, Sundown
    Montclair Film has added Zootopia 2 to its free Movie Nights Under the Stars series, screening at Essex County Brookdale Park (archery field) on Saturday August 29 at sundown (doors at 7pm) — a great late-summer family night with no tickets required; registration recommended at montclairfilm.org for weather alerts, rain date is Sunday August 30.
    Source: Montclair Film
  • $6.7M Vision Zero Investment: 12 Montclair Intersections to Get Major Safety Upgrades
    Montclair is activating $6.7 million in intersection safety upgrades at 12 high-risk locations as part of its Vision Zero initiative targeting zero traffic fatalities by 2028 — improvements include bollards, solar radar speed signs, and signal upgrades at the township's most dangerous crossings, good news for families navigating Montclair on foot or by bike.
    Source: Montclair Patch
  • New Montclair Traffic Calming: Linden Ave Goes One-Way, Speed Limits Reduced on Multiple Streets
    Montclair has reconfigured Linden Avenue to one-way traffic between Orange Road and Willowdale Avenue as a traffic calming measure, accompanied by speed limit reductions on key streets — part of the township's ongoing effort to lower crash rates following the addition of 14 new multi-way stops in 2024-25 under the Vision Zero roadmap.
    Source: Patch

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Four Days Out: Tackett Can Become First-Ever Title Defender in Series History
    No UFC BJJ championship has been defended since the series launched in January 2026 — Andrew Tackett enters Thursday's free YouTube stream (8pm ET, UFC Apex Las Vegas) with the chance to make history against Renato Canuto, while Mason Fowler and David Garmo contest the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight title in the co-main.
    Source: UFC
  • ADCC Krakow 47 Days Out: Training Camps Underway, Duarte-Simões Superfight and $362K Prize Pool in Focus
    With exactly 47 days until ADCC 2026 (September 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), top contenders including Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simões are in intensive training camp; the $362,000 prize-money event features the duo's anticipated superfight as its centerpiece, while women's -60kg frontrunner Helena Crevar carries a 21-consecutive-submission streak into what could be a historically dominant divisional performance.
    Source: ADCC News
  • No-Gi's Busiest Summer: UFC BJJ 2 Thursday, UFC BJJ 10 Women's Grand Prix August 20, ADCC September 12
    Three marquee events in seven weeks cement submission grappling's biggest commercial moment: UFC BJJ 2 (free, July 31), the first Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10 (August 20), and ADCC Krakow's 128-athlete world championship (September 12-13) — a sequence that solidifies no-gi's fastest-ever expansion across UFC, ADCC, and Fight to Win platforms.
    Source: FloGrappling

Global & European Soccer

  • Atletico's 13 World Cup Stars Begin Returning to Majadahonda — Full Squad Assembly Starts Today
    Atletico Madrid's World Cup contingent, including Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill plus Argentine finalists Álvarez, Almada, G. Simeone, and Molina, is beginning to check in at the Majadahonda training ground today and tomorrow (July 27-28), giving Diego Simeone his first near-complete session before the August 1 Stockholm pre-season opener against Manchester United.
    Source: Into the Calderon
  • Sorloth-Juventus Deadlocked Over ~€10M Fee Gap — Transfer Stalling With Atletico Pre-Season Underway
    The Alexander Sørloth departure from Atletico to Juventus remains unresolved: Atletico are holding firm at €35-40M while Juventus have proposed around €25-30M fixed plus bonuses, leaving a ~€10M gap despite personal terms already agreed by the Norwegian striker — an unresolved subplot as Simeone's squad prepares for the August 1 Stockholm friendly.
    Source: TransferFeed
  • Stockholm Five Days Out: Simeone Gets First Full-Squad Look at Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in Together
    With World Cup returnees arriving this week, August 1's Atletico vs. Manchester United friendly at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm (3pm CET) will be Simeone's first opportunity to field his three summer signings — left-back Alejandro Grimaldo, defensive midfielder Morten Hjulmand, and South Korean playmaker Lee Kang-in — alongside the core of the La Liga title-winning squad.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Oil Crashes 4-5% on Iran Ceasefire Pause — Markets Open Sharply Green With S&P Futures +0.79%, Nasdaq +1.34%
    A pause in US military strikes against Iran sent Brent crude tumbling 4.41% to $87.64 (from last week's $100+) and WTI down 4.93% to $84.91 on Monday morning, lifting S&P 500 futures 0.79% and Nasdaq 100 futures 1.34% — a sharp reversal of the geopolitical risk premium that had dragged VTI and tech stocks to their worst weekly loss since March.
    Source: Charles Schwab
  • AAPL Surges to $333 Near Record Highs — Three Days to Tim Cook's Farewell Earnings Call and Foldable iPhone Debut Hints
    Apple stock rallied 3.53% to $333 Monday on oil retreat relief and pre-earnings positioning, approaching all-time highs three days before Thursday's Q3 report ($1.89 EPS consensus, $108.9B revenue); alongside Tim Cook's final call before CEO successor John Ternus, investors will scrutinize iPhone 17 demand and early signals on Apple's foldable phone entry — Counterpoint Research forecasts a 25% global share in Apple's debut foldable year.
    Source: Benzinga
  • Megacap Gauntlet Week: FOMC Tuesday-Wednesday, Meta & MSFT Wednesday, Amazon & Apple Thursday — 34% Chance of Rate Hike
    The most consequential stretch of 2026's earnings season is now underway: the FOMC meets Tuesday-Wednesday (hawkish hold expected but 34% odds of a surprise hike), Meta and Microsoft report after Wednesday's close, and Amazon and Apple follow Thursday — while Spotify (SPOT, August 4, 8 days) and New Jersey's 6.87% 30-year refinance rate both hang on whether megacap beats can shift the Fed's messaging and bring bond yields lower.
    Source: TradingKey

NJ Local News

  • Two Downtown Montclair Retail Closings: Urban Outfitters and 24-Year-Old Culture Couture Gift Shop
    Montclair's downtown retail landscape shifted this week with two closings: Urban Outfitters is shutting its longtime Church Street location as part of a national chain-wide contraction, while Culture Couture — an independent gift shop at 53 Church Street that has served the community for 24 years — is closing its brick-and-mortar storefront, the latest change in a downtown that is simultaneously gaining 23 new businesses.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Clary Anderson Arena Under New Management: Montclair Takes Direct Control of Ice Rink From Outside Operator
    Montclair has resumed direct management of Clary Anderson Arena, replacing the outside rink-management company that previously operated the facility; community volunteers are assisting with operations during the transition, following earlier public reports of serious condition issues — the new arrangement signals a fresh chapter for one of the town's key recreational venues.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Annie at bergenPAC July 31–August 2 in Englewood — 15th-Anniversary Youth Production, Tickets From $37
    Bergen Performing Arts Center's Performing Arts School presents Annie at bergenPAC's Taub Stage (30 N Van Brunt St, Englewood, NJ) from July 31 through August 2, celebrating the program's 15th anniversary — performances July 31 at 7pm, August 1 at 3pm, and August 2 at 3pm, tickets from $37; an easy drive from Montclair and an ideal family outing coinciding with the Morimoto restaurant opening the same day.
    Source: bergenPAC

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • F2W 322 Fresno Wraps Up Today — California No-Gi Summer Swing Complete, ADCC Camp Mode Begins
    Fight to Win 322 concluded its Fresno card today (Saturday July 26), closing the California leg of the pre-ADCC summer circuit; with the West Coast swing complete, top ADCC-bound competitors now transition to full training-camp preparation for the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.
    Source: Fight 2 Win
  • UFC BJJ 2 Five Days Out — Two Title Fights Free on YouTube Thursday July 31 at 8pm ET
    UFC BJJ 2 is five days away at UFC Apex, Las Vegas, streaming free on YouTube at 8pm ET Thursday July 31, headlined by welterweight champion Andrew Tackett vs. Renato Canuto and Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo for the inaugural light heavyweight title — the last major grappling card before ADCC Krakow prep enters its final intensive phase.
    Source: UFC
  • ADCC 2026: Full 128-Athlete Field Locked, Elite Grapplers Enter Camp Phase — Krakow 48 Days Away
    All eight ADCC 2026 brackets are finalized with 128 confirmed athletes; with the pre-ADCC competition circuit winding down, top contenders including Kaynan Duarte, Yuri Simoes, and Gabi Garcia are entering dedicated training camps ahead of the September 12-13 World Championship at Tauron Arena Krakow — where 14-year-old Joslyn Molina will also make history in the women's -66kg division.
    Source: ADCC News

Global & European Soccer

  • Salah Nearing Besiktas Deal on Ronaldo-Style Contract — Atletico's Free-Agent Target Slips Away
    Mohamed Salah appears set to sign with Turkish club Besiktas on a 1+1 year contract at €12M annually, with CaughtOffside (July 25) confirming an agreement in principle and ESPN reporting he is 'nearing the move' — ending Atletico Madrid's months-long pursuit of the free-agent Egyptian forward and forcing the club to pivot their summer striker hunt.
    Source: CaughtOffside
  • Atletico's Striker Crisis: Salah Gone, Sorloth Departing — Gyokeres Swap With Arsenal Now the Only Path to a No. 9
    With Salah trending to Besiktas and Alexander Sorloth still en route to Juventus (personal terms agreed, clubs ~€5M apart on fee), Atletico face a genuine striker void; ESPN and Into the Calderon report the club are now more open to the Gyokeres-for-Alvarez swap with Arsenal — but only if Alvarez goes to the Premier League, not Barcelona, as Atletico's stance on their La Liga rivals remains firm.
    Source: ESPN
  • World Cup Players Return Monday — Atletico Assembles Near-Full Squad for Stockholm With 6 Days to Go
    Atletico Madrid's 13 World Cup participants — including Spanish champions Baena, Grimaldo, Llorente, and Pubill, plus Argentine finalists Alvarez, Almada, and Molina — are expected back at Majadahonda training by Monday July 28, giving Diego Simeone six days of near-full group sessions before the August 1 pre-season opener vs. Manchester United at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Biggest Earnings Week of 2026: Meta & Microsoft Wednesday, Amazon & Apple Thursday — Plus Fed Meeting, GDP and PCE Data
    The most consequential week of 2026 earnings season begins Monday with Meta and Microsoft reporting Wednesday (July 29), followed by Amazon and Apple on Thursday (July 30) after the bell; the Fed concludes its Wednesday policy meeting (rate hold expected), Q2 GDP prints Thursday morning, and PCE inflation data follows Friday — a five-day gauntlet that will determine whether the tech-led market selloff of the past two weeks has run its course.
    Source: CNBC
  • AAPL Enters Earnings Week Near $321 — 4 Days to Tim Cook's Farewell Call; ±5.38% Swing Priced In for July 30
    Apple opens the critical week near $321 with the market pricing a ±$16.61 (±5.38%) swing around Thursday July 30's Q3 print ($1.88 EPS consensus, $108.9B revenue, +20% YoY); Tim Cook delivers his final earnings call as CEO before John Ternus succession, with a strong beat on services revenue and AI spend narrative needed to push AAPL toward the $5T market-cap milestone — roughly $19/share above Friday's close.
    Source: Finance Calendar
  • NJ Refinance Holds at 6.698% as Fed Meets Wednesday; SPOT 9 Days Out — Analysts Shift Focus to Revenue Per User
    New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance APR holds at 6.698% (15-year: 5.83%) heading into the Fed's Wednesday rate decision, where a hold is expected to keep the improvement from the recent 7.02% peak intact; Spotify enters its final 9-day pre-earnings window ahead of its August 4 Q2 report ($3.29 EPS consensus, $5.6B revenue), with analysts now focused on revenue per user and operating income rather than raw subscriber additions.
    Source: Bankrate

NJ Local News

  • MM by Morimoto and Pig & Butter Both Open This Thursday July 31 — Montclair's Biggest Dining Day in Years
    Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's MM by Morimoto opens Thursday July 31 at 193 Glenridge Ave with exclusive fish from Japan, Wagyu beef, a custom omakase bar, and 200+ seats (book via Resy); simultaneously, Pig & Butter at 401 Orange Road celebrates its ribbon-cutting at 10am — two highly anticipated Montclair openings on the same day make July 31 a landmark moment for the local dining scene.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Nocturnal Animals at Van Vleck Gardens This Tuesday July 28 — Live Exotic Wildlife With Eyes of the Wild, 6–7pm
    Van Vleck House & Gardens (21 Van Vleck St, Montclair) hosts 'Outdoor Adventures: Nocturnal Animals' this Tuesday July 28 from 6–7pm, featuring live nocturnal animals from Eyes of the Wild exotic animal rescue — a low-key weeknight family outing for children ages 5 and older in one of Montclair's most beautiful garden settings.
    Source: MommyPoppins
  • Montclair Jazz Festival's Downtown Jamboree + Block Party Confirmed August 15 — 2026 Theme Honors American Jazz Cities
    The Montclair Jazz Festival's signature all-day Downtown Jamboree + Block Party is confirmed for Saturday August 15, 2026, celebrating this year's 'American Jazz Cities' theme highlighting Chicago, New York, and New Orleans; the festival's free weekly Soundcheck Series at Lackawanna Station continues on Tuesday evenings through August as a warm-up to the big day.
    Source: NJ Arts

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Six Days Out: Tackett vs. Canuto, Two Title Fights, Free on YouTube July 31
    With UFC BJJ 2 six days away (Thursday July 31, free on YouTube at 8pm ET from UFC Apex, Las Vegas), the double-title card is set: welterweight champion Andrew Tackett defends against submission specialist Renato Canuto in the main event, while Mason Fowler and David Garmo crown the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight champion in the co-main — the free stream marks the second event in a planned 14-card 2026 series.
    Source: UFC
  • Fight to Win 322 Tonight in Fresno — Final Pre-ADCC California Stop as Krakow Prep Begins
    Fight to Win's California summer double-header wraps tonight with F2W 322 in Fresno — the last West Coast showcase before the grappling community enters full ADCC training-camp mode, with seven weeks remaining until the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.
    Source: Fight 2 Win
  • ADCC Krakow Bracket Finalized: Pearman Replaces Michell at 77kg; Hamilton Steps Into Fornarino's -55kg Slot
    The ADCC 2026 roster reshuffle is complete: Taylor Pearman slots into the 77kg bracket in place of the removed Izaak Michell, while Valerie Hamilton takes the -55kg women's spot vacated by Adele Fornarino, who chose the UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix over Krakow — closing the book on five competitor withdrawals ahead of the September 12-13 World Championship.
    Source: Yahoo Sports

Global & European Soccer

  • Alvarez-Gyokeres Swap Still Frozen — Player Wants Barcelona, Atletico Won't Budge
    Reports from CaughtOffside (July 25) confirm the Arsenal-Atletico framework pairing Viktor Gyokeres plus cash for Julian Alvarez remains in place but completely stalled: Alvarez wants Barcelona, Atletico refuses to sell him there as a matter of principle, and with the August 1 Stockholm friendly one week away Simeone's side shows no sign of breaking the deadlock.
    Source: CaughtOffside
  • One Week to Pre-Season: Atletico vs. Man United in Stockholm August 1 at Strawberry Arena
    Atletico Madrid's 2026-27 pre-season opener is exactly one week away — Saturday August 1 at 3pm CET at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm vs. Manchester United — when Simeone gets his first look at summer arrivals Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in together in a competitive environment ahead of the La Liga title defense opener at Espanyol (August 16-17).
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • La Liga 2026-27 Season Opens August 16-17 — Atletico Away at Espanyol's RCDE Stadium for Title Defense Debut
    La Liga's 2026-27 season kicks off the weekend of August 16-17, with Atletico Madrid opening their title defense away at Espanyol's RCDE Stadium — giving Simeone's revamped squad just two pre-season tests (Stockholm vs. Man United Aug 1, Seoul vs. Man City Aug 9) to integrate three summer signings before competitive action begins.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Markets Post Worst Week Since March — Brent Hits $100, S&P 500 Down 0.6%, Nasdaq Off 2%
    All three major US indices closed the week of July 21-25 in the red: the S&P 500 fell 0.6% to 7,411 and the Nasdaq lost 2% — its second consecutive weekly decline — as Brent crude's surge past $100/barrel on Houthi tanker attacks and Iran tensions added an inflation premium dragging VTI from recent highs; Apple's July 30 earnings report is now the single most-watched market event of the summer.
    Source: CNBC

    Reigning ADCC -55kg double gold medalist Adele Fornarino has been pulled from the Krakow 2026 roster after choosing to compete in the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10 (August 20), while ADCC Asia & Oceania Trials winner Izaak Michell was simultaneously removed over an active Texas arrest warrant — the 4th and 5th departures from a September 12-13 bracket that has now lost five confirmed competitors in quick succession.
    Source: MMA Mania
  • UFC BJJ 10 Announces Inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix for August 20 — Fornarino vs. Brunacio Headline
    The UFC's no-gi grappling series announced a landmark addition to its August 20 card at the Meta Apex: the first-ever Women's Flyweight Grand Prix at UFC BJJ 10, with ADCC double champion Adele Fornarino facing Brazilian standout Carol Brunacio in the tournament semifinals — the winner of the four-woman bracket will be crowned the inaugural UFC BJJ Women's Flyweight Champion.

    Tonight's Karate Combat 62 / Pit Submission Series 7 card in Miami features Jacob Rodriguez ending a 17-month competitive absence against veteran Vagner Rocha in the PSS main event — a high-stakes grappling match just seven weeks before ADCC Krakow, with both men expected to compete at the September 12-13 World Championship.

    With eight days until UFC BJJ 2 (July 31, free on YouTube at 8pm ET), the Fowler-Garmo co-main event is shaping up as the bout to watch — Mason Fowler brings a three-fight UFC BJJ submission run against a surging David Garmo, and the inaugural light heavyweight title gives the matchup lasting significance beyond a single night.

    Club captain Jorge Resurrección 'Koke' has signed a one-year contract extension keeping him at Atletico Madrid through June 2027, the club announced, with both parties activating an automatic renewal clause; the 34-year-old one-club man becomes the squad's continuity anchor in a summer that has seen significant turnover around him.

  • Musumeci-Mitchell Crossover Officially Scheduled: UFC BJJ 11, September 24, Las Vegas
    After weeks as a 'homeless' challenge, the Mikey Musumeci vs. Bryce Mitchell crossover is confirmed for UFC BJJ 11 on September 24 at Meta Apex, Las Vegas; Mitchell becomes the first active UFC fighter to compete in the UFC BJJ series, facing flyweight champion Musumeci (4-0, all submissions) in a non-title featherweight bout, with Mason Fowler defending his UFC BJJ light heavyweight title vs. 2019 ADCC runner-up Nick Rodriguez in the co-main event.

    The full 10-bout UFC BJJ 2 card is set for the free July 31 YouTube stream (8pm ET): Andrew Tackett defends his welterweight title vs. Renato Canuto in the main event and Fowler vs. Garmo crowns the inaugural light heavyweight champion in the co-main — a compelling family subplot sees Andrew's brother William Tackett and Renato's wife Raquel Canuto both making their UFC BJJ debuts on the undercard.
    Source: UFC
  • UFC BJJ Series Maps to Event 11 — With 14 Cards Planned in 2026, No-Gi's Fastest-Growing League Keeps Expanding
    The announcement of UFC BJJ 11 (September 24) — featuring Musumeci-Mitchell headlining and Fowler-Rodriguez in the co-main — shows how quickly the series has scaled since its January 2026 debut; with 14 events planned for the calendar year and a growing roster of champions across weight classes, the UFC's no-gi circuit is cementing its place alongside ADCC, Polaris, and Fight to Win as a top-tier destination for elite grapplers.
    Source: FloGrappling

Global & European Soccer

    Arsenal have proposed sending Swedish striker Viktor Gyokeres (valued at €65M+) plus approximately €60M cash to Atletico Madrid in exchange for Julian Alvarez — a structure that emerged after Atletico blocked a direct Alvarez sale to La Liga rivals Barcelona 'as a matter of honor'; TEAMtalk reports no agreement has been struck yet but lines of communication between the clubs remain open.
    Source: FootballTransfers
  • Atletico Pre-Season Week 2: Full Squad Expected by July 28 — Four Days to Prepare for Stockholm Aug 1
    Non-World-Cup players are training at Majadahonda this week while Spanish and Argentine World Cup finalists remain on mandatory extended rest; the full group including Grimaldo, Baena, Alvarez, G. Simeone, and Almada is expected to reassemble by July 28, giving Simeone just four training sessions before the August 1 Stockholm friendly vs. Manchester United at Strawberry Arena.
    Source: Football Espana

    Atletico's summer transfer math is evolving rapidly: if the Alvarez-Gyokeres swap closes, the Swedish striker fills the void left by Sorloth's imminent Juventus departure, while the Mohamed Salah free-agent pursuit continues in parallel — Simeone could end the 2026 window with an entirely new front three compared to the La Liga title-winning season.

    With VTI dipping to 369.45 and Apple shares consolidating near $325-330, the July 30 Q3 earnings call is shaping up as a milestone: analysts project $1.88 EPS on ~$109B revenue, but the bigger story is that July 30 will mark Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO — hardware executive John Ternus takes over as Apple's next chief, and a strong beat could push AAPL's market cap past $5 trillion for the first time.

    With seven weeks until the September 12–13 ADCC World Championship at Tauron Arena Kraków, the headline Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simões superfight is set but divisional races remain wide open — particularly in women's -60kg where Helena Crevar enters as an overwhelming favorite after extending her submission streak to 21, and in -66kg where 14-year-old Joslyn Molina faces a world-class adult field.

    England claimed World Cup bronze by beating France 2-1 in a match broadcasters called an 'instant classic' — ending Kylian Mbappé's 2026 campaign without a winner's medal and giving England their best finish at a World Cup since their 1966 triumph; the result set the stage for today's Spain-Argentina final at MetLife.

    With the full ADCC 2026 roster locked and eight weeks until the September 12-13 World Championship, the key storylines are set: Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes in the vacated absolute superfight, Joslyn Molina (14) making history in -65kg, and Gabi Garcia returning for a seventh ADCC — all at Tauron Arena Krakow.

    Spain's 4-3-3 will feature Lamine Yamal, Mikel Oyarzabal, and Alex Baena up front with Rodri, Fabian Ruiz, and Dani Olmo in midfield; Argentina counter with Messi, Julian Alvarez, and Giuliano Simeone attacking and Mac Allister, Enzo Fernandez, and Paredes behind — kick-off Sunday 3pm ET on Fox at MetLife Stadium.

    Atletico Madrid CEO Miguel Angel Gil confirmed Friday the club will not sell Julian Alvarez this summer for any price — rejecting reported 100M+ euro offers from both Barcelona and Arsenal and restating the 500M euro release clause stands — a bombshell reversal that ends the transfer saga just hours before Alvarez starts in Sunday's Final.

    Heading into Sunday's Final, Lionel Messi leads the tournament with 8 goals and extends his own record for all-time World Cup goals to 25 across four tournaments, becoming the first player to reach four World Cup Finals — at 39, this is almost certainly his farewell, with Argentina aiming to become the first back-to-back champions since Brazil in 1962.

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Crevar Extends to 21 Straight Submissions at ONE Inner Circle 22, Stops Clymer in Bangkok
    Helena Crevar picked up her 21st consecutive submission victory at ONE Inner Circle 22 in Bangkok, finishing Paige Ivette Clymer by inside heel hook at Lumpinee Stadium to complete her pre-ADCC season with eight weeks remaining before the September 12-13 World Championship in Krakow.
    Source: ONE Championship
  • ADCC Krakow Roster Finalized: Gabi Garcia Returns for Women's Heavyweight, Andrey and Gamrot Complete 128-Person Field
    The full 128-person ADCC 2026 World Championship bracket is confirmed for Krakow with notable late additions: submission grappling legend Gabi Garcia accepted a surprise women's heavyweight invite, while Fabricio Andrey (66kg) and UFC veteran Mateusz Gamrot (77kg) fill the final men's slots despite the headline absences of three defending champions.
    Source: Yardbarker
  • UFC BJJ 2 Grows to Two-Title Event July 31: Fowler vs. Garmo Added for Inaugural Light Heavyweight Championship
    The July 31 UFC BJJ 2 card expanded to a double-championship event with Mason Fowler facing David Garmo for the first-ever light heavyweight belt alongside the welterweight main event between champion Andrew Tackett and Renato Canuto; both title bouts stream live and free on UFC's YouTube channel at 8pm ET.
    Source: UFC

Global & European Soccer

  • World Cup Final Preview: Spain's Record Defense vs. Messi's Last Stand — Sunday 3pm ET at MetLife
    Spain enter Sunday's MetLife Final as marginal favorites with a tournament-record six clean sheets and just one goal conceded in seven games; Argentina counter with Lionel Messi widely expected to be playing his last World Cup match, and the resilience of a team that came from 1-0 down to beat England in added time — back-to-back champions Argentina seek what would be a feat unseen since Brazil in 1962.
    Source: NBC Sports
  • Arsenal's Final Push: Gunners in Direct Talks to Sign Álvarez Before July 20 Pre-Season as Clock Runs Out
    Arsenal sporting director Berta is in direct talks to finalize a deal for Julián Álvarez before the Gunners' July 20 pre-season kicks off — Atlético Madrid have green-lit the sale to Arsenal but refuse to deal with Barcelona (a La Liga rival), giving Arsenal the path to a ~£100M signing even as Álvarez himself reportedly prefers a Barcelona move that Atlético won't allow.
    Source: Goal.com
  • La Roja Lands in Montclair: Team Spain Checks Into MC Hotel Ahead of Sunday's World Cup Final
    After flying from Dallas overnight, Team Spain settled into the MC Hotel on Valley Road in Montclair — the World Cup's go-to base for MetLife-area teams — with fans lining up outside for glimpses of Lamine Yamal and teammates; the hotel's Allegory bar and Splendid Rooftop are closed to the public through Sunday July 19 for Spain's full venue buyout.

Financial Freedom & Markets

    Stocks fell Thursday after TSMC raised its 2026 capex forecast to $60-64B (up from $52-56B), stoking concerns about AI spending sustainability; the Nasdaq dropped 1.47% to 25,882 and the S&P 500 fell 0.51% to 7,534, dragging VTI back from near its 52-week high of $374.70 — AAPL held relatively firm near $327 heading into the July 30 Q3 earnings report.

    The One Big Beautiful Budget Act (OBBBA) raised the federal SALT deduction cap from $10,000 to $40,000 (effective 2025-2029), letting most NJ homeowners who itemize fully deduct their state and local taxes on federal returns — potentially saving hundreds to thousands annually; the deduction phases out above $500K MAGI and reverts to $10,000 in 2030 without further Congressional action.
    Source: Wiss

    Saturday July 18, FilmOneFest hosts an outdoor short film showcase in Jersey City (6pm–11pm) with a Manhattan skyline backdrop — a great movie night for families about 30 minutes from Montclair near Liberty State Park, and a perfect complement to World Cup Final weekend.

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ONE Inner Circle 22 Friday: Crevar vs. Clymer Is a Keenan-vs-Danaher Coaching Clash Nine Weeks Before ADCC
    ONE Championship has published a full profile of debutant Paige Ivette Clymer ahead of Friday's submission grappling match against Helena Crevar, describing her as a relentless Legion AJJ pressure passer trained by Keenan Cornelius — setting up a philosophically fascinating Keenan vs. Danaher coaching matchup nine weeks before both women compete at ADCC Krakow.
    Source: ONE Championship
  • ADCC Krakow Ticket Sales Near 4 Per Day; Duarte-Simoes Superfight Is Now the Event's Clear Top Billing
    With three defending champions absent, the Ruotolo twins out, and Gordon Ryan retired, the 15,030-seat Tauron Arena Kraków remains far from sold out ahead of the September 12-13 World Championships; the Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes openweight superfight for Gordon Ryan's vacated title and 14-year-old Joslyn Molina's -65kg appearance are the event's most compelling drawing cards.
    Source: BJJ World
  • Jacob Rodriguez Returns to Competition July 24 After 17-Month Hiatus at Pit Submission Series
    Former ADCC silver medalist Jacob Rodriguez will end a 17-month absence from professional grappling on July 24 at the Pit Submission Series — a notable return arriving just seven weeks before ADCC Krakow, where he is expected to compete.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe

Global & European Soccer

  • Spain 2-0 France: Yamal Draw Earns Penalty, Porro Finishes — La Roja in First World Cup Final Since 2010
    Lamine Yamal drew a Digne foul for Oyarzabal's 22nd-minute penalty, then Pedro Porro added a 58th-minute strike as Spain dominated France 2-0 at AT&T Stadium on Monday — sending La Roja to the July 19 MetLife Final for the first time since 2010 and ending Mbappé's tournament without a showpiece.
    Source: NBC News
  • England vs. Argentina SF Today 3pm ET in Atlanta: Messi's 21 World Cup Goals vs. Kane — MetLife Spot on the Line
    The second 2026 World Cup semifinal kicks off today (3pm ET on Fox) at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, with Lionel Messi — sole holder of the all-time World Cup goals record at 21 — leading Argentina against Harry Kane and England, who seek their first Final appearance since 1966 and would face Spain at MetLife on Saturday.
    Source: ESPN
  • Atlético Transfer Desk: Arsenal Enters Álvarez Race — Formal Talks Expected This Week as Argentina's WC Run Ends Today
    The Hard Tackle reports Atlético Madrid is open to selling Julián Álvarez to Arsenal, making the Premier League club the third major suitor alongside Barcelona and PSG; with Argentina's World Cup run ending today in the semifinal, formal transfer negotiations are expected to begin imminently with the fee target in the €130-150M range.
    Source: The Hard Tackle

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • VTI Near $372 Midweek as Warsh Enters Day 2 of Fed Testimony; July 30 Apple Earnings Now Top Market Catalyst
    VTI holds near $372 — close to its 52-week high of $374.70 — as new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh enters the second day of his inaugural congressional testimony; with June CPI digested and bank earnings mostly in, Apple's July 30 Q3 print is now the single most closely-watched near-term catalyst for both tech and the broader market.
    Source: Tickeron
  • AAPL 15 Days to Earnings: Near ATH at $317, China iPhone Shipments Up 20-25%; Analysts Target $1.88 EPS
    Apple shares trade near $317 — modestly below last week's all-time high of $323.45 — as the July 30 Q3 earnings date approaches; analysts project $1.88 EPS (up ~20% YoY) on ~$108.9B revenue, with fresh data showing iPhone China shipments up 20-25% YoY in Q2 adding a positive pre-earnings signal.
    Source: MarketBeat
  • NJ 30-Year Refinance Rate Ticks to 6.66% — Still a Viable Window for Homeowners Who Locked In Near 2023's 8% Peak
    New Jersey's 30-year fixed refinance rate edged to 6.66% (15-year: 5.86%) as of July 14, slightly above the 6.13% reading earlier in the month; homeowners who financed near the 2023 peak of ~8% still have a meaningful rate-reduction window, though economists caution that a hawkish Fed September pivot could push rates higher.
    Source: Bankrate

NJ Local News

  • Act Now: MM by Morimoto Reservations Open TOMORROW on Resy — Montclair's Most Anticipated Restaurant Opening of 2026
    Reservations for MM by Morimoto open on Resy tomorrow (July 16), two weeks before the July 31 dinner launch at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair — the 200-seat Japanese steakhouse from Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto features A5 Wagyu, omakase bar, tuna pizza, and fish flown from Japan, and is expected to be one of North Jersey's most in-demand tables.
    Source: Jersey Digs
  • Final Weekend: Free Outdoor 'Much Ado About Nothing' at Van Vleck House & Gardens Through Saturday July 18
    The Studio Players' outdoor Shakespeare production runs through this Saturday July 18 at Van Vleck House & Gardens in Montclair — free admission, no tickets required, and perfect for a summer evening family outing before World Cup Final weekend.
    Source: Experience Montclair
  • Seussical Jr. at UCPAC July 17-19 — Family Musical This Weekend in Cranford, 20 Minutes From Montclair
    CAU Community Players bring Seussical Jr. to the Union County Performing Arts Center in Cranford this Friday through Sunday (July 17-19) — the beloved Dr. Seuss mashup featuring Cat in the Hat and Horton, a great family theater option for kids 10-13 about 20 minutes from Montclair.
    Source: NJ Stage

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ONE: The Inner Circle July 17 Preview — Ruotolo Fights Tetsuka in MMA; Crevar vs. Clymer in Grappling
    Thursday's ONE: The Inner Circle card at Lumpinee Stadium in Bangkok features Kade Ruotolo facing Hiroyuki Tetsuka in an MMA clash alongside women's grappling #1 Helena Crevar battling ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a submission grappling match.
    Source: SportsKeeda
  • Joslyn Molina, 14, Confirmed as Youngest-Ever ADCC Worlds Competitor for Krakow September 12-13
    Joslyn Molina has officially accepted her invitation to the -65kg division at ADCC 2026 in Krakow, making her the youngest competitor in ADCC history; ADCC amended its minimum-age policy after Molina won bronze at the East Coast Trials competing against adult opponents.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe

Global & European Soccer

  • World Cup SF Today: France vs. Spain at AT&T Stadium Dallas (3pm ET) — Winner to MetLife Final July 19
    The first 2026 World Cup semifinal kicks off this afternoon with Kylian Mbappé (7 goals) leading France against Lamine Yamal and Spain; the winner earns a spot in Saturday's Final at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ — now five days away.
    Source: ESPN
  • England vs. Argentina SF Tomorrow July 15, Atlanta (3pm ET): Kane & Bellingham vs. Messi — Final Spot at Stake
    Wednesday's second World Cup semifinal at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta has England chasing their first Final since 1966, with Kane and Bellingham each on 6 tournament goals, against Messi's Argentina (8 goals, 2022 defending champions); analysts predict a tight, low-scoring affair.
    Source: Al Jazeera
  • Álvarez Transfer Breakthrough: Apollo Sports Capital Now Backing Sale; Lamine Yamal Made Personal Request
    In the biggest shift yet in the Julián Álvarez saga, Atlético's majority shareholders Apollo Sports Capital are increasingly prepared to sanction a transfer to Barcelona, while Lamine Yamal has personally requested the club sign the striker; formal talks resume once Argentina exits the World Cup.
    Source: Football Transfers

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • June CPI Released: Headline Falls to ~3.9% on Gas Price Drop; Core Sticky at 2.85% — Warsh Testimony Begins Today
    The BLS released June CPI this morning (8:30am ET): headline inflation fell from 4.2% to approximately 3.9% YoY, driven by a ~10% drop in gasoline prices from the US-Iran ceasefire; core CPI held at ~2.85% — well above the Fed's 2% target — with new Chair Kevin Warsh beginning his inaugural congressional testimony today and the July FOMC rate decision now in sharp focus.
    Source: Kiplinger
  • AAPL Hits All-Time High $323.45; Citi Raises Target to $365 Ahead of July 30 Earnings
    Apple shares set a new intraday all-time high of $323.45 on July 13 (closing at $317.31) after Citi upgraded its price target from $315 to $365, citing AI strategy momentum and continued market share gains; July 30 Q3 earnings are next, where analysts project $1.89 EPS on 14-17% revenue growth.
    Source: FX Leaders
  • Spotify Earnings Confirmed August 4 — Later Than Expected; Q1 Beat Showed 761M MAU, Analyst Consensus $678
    Spotify's next earnings date is confirmed as August 4 before market open, later than the widely-reported July 29 date; Q1 2026 delivered 761M monthly active users (+12% YoY) and $5.3B revenue (+8%), with soft Q2 guidance weighing on shares despite a $678 analyst consensus target implying ~40% upside.
    Source: Market Chameleon

NJ Local News

  • Ocean County Fair Opens Tomorrow July 15 Through July 19 — Rides, 4-H Animals, Fair Food, $10 Admission
    The five-day Ocean County Fair runs July 15-19 at Robert J. Miller Air Park in Berkeley Township (~70 miles from Montclair near Exit 88 GSP), featuring 4-H animal exhibits, carnival rides, live entertainment, and classic fair food; admission is $10 for adults, free for kids under 10.
    Source: NJ Family
  • Where to Watch the World Cup Final July 19 Near Montclair — Free Fan Zone at Liberty State Park, NJ DOT Advisory
    For fans unable to pay $8K+ for MetLife tickets, the official FIFA Fan Festival at Liberty State Park in Jersey City (free, opens 9am July 19) is about 20 minutes from Montclair; NJ DOT has issued traffic advisories for the MetLife area with heavy congestion expected around Route 3 from midday Saturday.
    Source: NJ Family
  • Two Free Movies Coming Up: Zootopia 2 at State Theatre NJ July 21; 'Best in Show' at Anderson Park July 26
    Next Tuesday July 21, State Theatre NJ in New Brunswick screens Zootopia 2 for free (10:30am and 6:30pm showings, crafts at 5:30pm); Sunday July 26, Montclair Film's 'Movie Night Under the Stars' shows 'Best in Show' free at Anderson Park with a pre-show dog parade — two free family film outings back-to-back.
    Source: State Theatre NJ

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Polaris 38: Szczecinski Wins Welterweight GP, Sarah Galvao Captures Bantamweight Title
    At Polaris 38 on July 11, Mateusz Szczecinski won the welterweight grand prix with three straight wins and a $30,000 prize; Sarah Galvao submitted Zara Di Tofano with an arm-triangle choke to claim the Polaris bantamweight championship.
    Source: Jits Magazine
  • Kade Ruotolo Returns From Injury to Defend ONE Lightweight Title This Thursday; Crevar–Clymer Also on Card
    After withdrawing injured in June, Kade Ruotolo is back to defend his ONE Lightweight Submission Grappling World Title at ONE: The Inner Circle on July 17 in Bangkok — with women's #1 P4P Helena Crevar vs. ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer on the same card.
    Source: MMA Sucka
  • ADCC Miami Open Concluded July 11 — Last Major North American Qualifier Before Krakow Worlds
    The ADCC Miami-Dade Open wrapped Saturday July 11 at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition, awarding 9 world ranking points to first-place finishers in the final major North American qualifier before September's ADCC World Championship in Krakow, Poland.
    Source: ADCC Combat

Global & European Soccer

  • World Cup SFs Kick Off Tomorrow: France vs. Spain (July 14, Dallas, 3pm ET) and England vs. Argentina (July 15, Atlanta)
    The 2026 World Cup semifinals feature the first-ever bracket with FIFA's top-four ranked nations — France (1st) vs. Spain (3rd) at AT&T Stadium tomorrow at 3pm ET on Fox, and Argentina (2nd) vs. England (4th) Wednesday in Atlanta; winners meet at MetLife Stadium, NJ on July 19.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • World Cup Final at MetLife July 19: BTS, Shakira, Justin Bieber Halftime Show; Resale From $8K
    The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final comes to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ on July 19 at 3pm ET — 12 miles from Montclair — with a halftime show featuring BTS, Shakira, and Justin Bieber; secondary market resale starts at roughly $8,000–$9,775 for upper-deck seats.
    Source: MetLife Stadium
  • Sørloth Exit From Atlético Expected After Norway's QF Loss to England — Juventus Deal Nears Completion
    Alexander Sørloth's Norway fell 2-1 to England in the quarterfinals on July 11 (Jude Bellingham scored twice), ending his World Cup; the result clears the way for his Juventus transfer — Atlético and Juventus remain about €5M apart on a fee of ~€30–35M, with a deal expected imminently.
    Source: Into the Calderon
  • Álvarez Transfer on Hold Until Argentina's World Cup Run Ends; Barcelona Readying Post-Tournament Bid
    With Julián Álvarez still competing with Argentina (SF vs. England, July 15), Barcelona has paused formal transfer negotiations until the World Cup concludes; the club is expected to submit a revised bid close to €130M after Argentina's exit or the final.
    Source: Football Transfers

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Big Week: June CPI Tuesday, Fed Chair Warsh Inaugural Testimony, Q2 Earnings Season Kicks Off
    Markets face a critical week with June CPI data Tuesday (consensus +3.8% YoY, down from May's 4.2%), new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inaugural congressional testimony Tuesday–Wednesday, and Q2 earnings season launching with JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, BofA, Netflix, and TSMC all reporting.
    Source: CNBC
  • Apple Sues OpenAI for AI Hardware Trade Secret Theft — AAPL at $315, July 30 Earnings Next
    Apple filed a landmark lawsuit against OpenAI on July 10, alleging former Apple execs at Jony Ive's io Products directed job candidates to bring Apple parts and download confidential specs; AAPL closed near $315 and the July 30 fiscal Q3 earnings call is the next major catalyst.
    Source: CNBC
  • Spotify SPOT Down 38% From ATH but Consensus Target $678 — July 29 Earnings the Reset Catalyst
    Spotify shares are roughly 38% below their all-time high, but JPMorgan raised its target to $650 and Wells Fargo to $600, pushing the Street consensus to $678 (~40% upside from current levels); Q2 earnings are due July 29 before market open, with analysts watching MAU (target 778M) and gross margins (target 33%+).
    Source: Benzinga
  • NJ ANCHOR Payments Start September 15 — Up to $1,500 for Homeowners; Mortgage Rate Rises to 6.49%
    New Jersey's ANCHOR property tax relief program will begin distributing 2026 payments on September 15, with eligible homeowners receiving up to $1,500 ($1,750 with senior bonus); separately, NJ's 30-year fixed mortgage rate has risen to 6.49% this week ahead of Tuesday's critical June CPI report.
    Source: Kiplinger

NJ Local News

  • World Cup Final at MetLife July 19 — Six Days Away, NJ's Biggest Sports Event in 32 Years
    The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final comes to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford on July 19 at 3pm ET — 12 miles from Montclair — with BTS, Shakira, and Justin Bieber performing at halftime; the largest sporting event ever held in NJ and the last chance to see the World Cup in person this summer.
    Source: MetLife Stadium
  • Adventure Aquarium 'Shark & Ray Summer Adventure' Opens Today — July 13 Through August 16 in Camden
    Adventure Aquarium's Shark & Ray Summer Adventure kicks off today in Camden, featuring the Northeast's largest shark collection alongside daily marine biologist talks, hands-on ray encounters, sing-alongs, and dance parties — a family-friendly destination about 90 minutes from Montclair.
    Source: NJ Family

    The Montclair Jazz Festival's free outdoor Soundcheck Series continues Monday July 14 with pianist Michele Rosewoman and her acclaimed Afro-Cuban ensemble Quintessence at Lackawanna Station; free and open to all, part of the summer series leading to the August 15 Downtown Jamboree.
    Source: Montclair Jazz Festival
  • Car-Free Church Street Weekend Returns July 17–19 — Outdoor Dining, Shops, No Traffic
    Montclair's second pedestrian weekend of 2026 closes Church Street to vehicles from 10am–10pm July 17–19, turning the restaurant-lined block into an outdoor plaza — a great family outing near The Clairidge theater, running concurrently with the World Cup Final weekend.
    Source: Montclair Local

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ADCC Miami Open Registration Closes Tomorrow — Weigh-Ins Friday, Competition Saturday July 11
    The ADCC Miami-Dade Open at the Miami-Dade County Fair & Exposition holds weigh-ins July 10 (4–7pm) and competition July 11, with registration closing Thursday July 9; first-place finishers earn 9 ADCC world ranking points in the last major North American opportunity to build toward September's Krakow World Championship.
    Source: ADCC Combat
  • Helena Crevar vs. Paige Ivette Clymer at ONE: Inner Circle July 17 — Women's Top-Ranked Grappler Returns to Bangkok
    Women's world #1 P4P Helena Crevar faces ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a 10-minute openweight submission match at Lumpinee Stadium on July 17 — the second ONE Championship appearance for the 19-year-old black belt and a high-profile tune-up nine weeks before ADCC Krakow.
    Source: ONE Championship
  • Musumeci vs. Mitchell: Match Accepted by Both Men, Still No Promotion or Date
    A week after Bryce Mitchell's callout and Mikey Musumeci's full acceptance, no organization has stepped forward to host their crossover grappling match; both fighters remain publicly committed but the bout is stuck in limbo until a promotion steps up.
    Source: Low Kick MMA

Global & European Soccer

  • France vs. Morocco World Cup QF Tomorrow (July 9, 4pm ET) — Mbappé's 7 Goals vs. Unbeaten Atlas Lions
    France arrive at Gillette Stadium unbeaten in five games with 14 goals and only two conceded, with Mbappé setting a new World Cup knockout-stage scoring record at 7 goals; Morocco are equally unbeaten and meet France for the second time in three World Cups after their 2022 semifinal defeat.
    Source: FIFA
  • Spain vs. Belgium QF Friday July 10 at SoFi Stadium (3pm ET) — Five Clean Sheets vs. Tournament's Biggest Attack
    Spain reach Los Angeles with five consecutive clean sheets including a grinding 1-0 over Portugal; Belgium, who demolished the USMNT 4-1, bring De Bruyne and Lukaku as the most dangerous attack Spain have faced — making this the quarterfinal most likely to produce an upset.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • Álvarez Transfer Saga Intensifies: Barcelona Sets World Cup Deadline; Atlético Cites €500M Clause
    Julián Álvarez publicly confirmed he wants out of Atlético — telling reporters his departure 'is the best thing for everyone' — while Barcelona has given Atlético a World Cup-end deadline and will move to other targets if no deal is struck; Atlético sources insist no fee short of the €500M release clause is acceptable.
    Source: Barca Blaugranes
  • Lee Kang-in Still Awaiting Official Atlético Announcement — €40M+ Fee Confirmed, 5-Year Contract Agreed
    Despite Fabrizio Romano's 'Here We Go' on July 7, Atlético Madrid still had not posted an official announcement for Lee Kang-in's signing from PSG as of July 8; Korean media confirm the total fee lands slightly above €40M with bonuses on a deal through 2031, making him the first Asian player in club history.
    Source: Korea JoongAng Daily

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Chip Sell-Off Resumes: Samsung Miss + DeepSeek AI News Sinks Nasdaq 1.16%, VTI Pulls Back From $372
    U.S. stocks fell Tuesday after Samsung's disappointing earnings and reports that China's DeepSeek is developing its own proprietary AI chip triggered fresh semiconductor selling; the Nasdaq dropped 1.16%, the S&P 500 fell 0.45% to 7,503, the Dow lost 130 points to 52,925, and VTI retreated from its recent high near $372.
    Source: TheStreet
  • AAPL Dips to ~$310 as Analyst Warns Foldable iPhone Supply Issues Could Miss September Launch
    Apple stock slipped in premarket Wednesday after an analyst warned that supply constraints on the foldable 'iPhone Ultra' could push its launch past September 2026; AAPL closed at ~$310 Tuesday, down from its recent $315 high, with the July 30 Q3 earnings call as the next major catalyst.
    Source: StockTwits
  • SPOT Up ~6% in Early July Heading Into July 29 Earnings — 34 of 40 Analysts Rate Buy
    Spotify shares have gained roughly 6% since July 1 as investors position for the July 29 Q2 earnings call, where consensus targets 778M monthly active users, 33%+ gross margins, and EPS of ~$3.18; Bank of America's $685 Buy target and the majority analyst consensus make this one of the more anticipated tech earnings of the summer.

  • NJ Senior Freeze Property Tax Checks Begin July 15 — ANCHOR in September; 30-Year Refinance at 6.13%
    New Jersey's Senior Freeze (PTR) program begins mailing 2026 property tax reimbursement checks July 15 for eligible homeowners 65+; ANCHOR benefits arrive in September and Stay NJ in February 2027 — meanwhile, the 30-year fixed refinance rate in NJ sits at about 6.13%, down sharply from the 2023 peak near 8%.

NJ Local News

  • Newark Black Film Festival Opens TONIGHT at Newark Museum of Art — Free Screening of 'When We Free the World'
    The 52nd Newark Black Film Festival launches tonight July 8 at 6:30pm with an Opening Night Reception and screening of 'When We Free the World' at the Newark Museum of Art; the free (reservation required) series runs every Wednesday through August 5 — about 12 miles from Montclair via the Garden State Parkway.
    Source: Newark Black Film Festival
  • Montclair Jazz Soundcheck: Michele Rosewoman & Quintessence Next Monday July 14 at Lackawanna Station — Free
    The Montclair Jazz Festival's free outdoor Soundcheck Series continues with jazz pianist and Afro-Cuban ensemble leader Michele Rosewoman and her group Quintessence next Monday July 14 at Lackawanna Station; the series runs through August 4 ahead of the August 15 Downtown Jamboree headlined by Dianne Reeves and Christian McBride.

  • State Theatre Free Movies: Lilo & Stitch Next Tuesday July 14 in New Brunswick — Two Showings, Crafts at 5:30pm
    The State Theatre NJ's free Summer Movies Series continues next Tuesday July 14 with Lilo & Stitch (10:30am and 6:30pm showings), with movie-themed arts and crafts starting at 5:30pm before the evening showing; remaining dates are Zootopia 2 (July 21) and How to Train Your Dragon (July 28) — all free on a 46-foot screen in New Brunswick.
    Source: State Theatre NJ

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Mikey Musumeci Accepts Bryce Mitchell's Grappling Challenge After 'Gay' Comment
    Bryce Mitchell publicly challenged Mikey Musumeci while saying he refuses to watch BJJ because it's "gay"; Musumeci fired back with a full acceptance and jokingly ruled out leg locks and guard pulling, and Mitchell confirmed the match is on — though no date or promotion has been announced.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe
  • ADCC 2026 Quietly Removes Izaak Michell From Krakow Roster Amid Active Arrest Warrants
    ADCC has removed Izaak Michell from its official Krakow competitor list after months of controversy — including Craig Jones withdrawing his $48k equal-pay pledge in protest — following reports that Michell faces two active Texas arrest warrants related to sexual assault allegations.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe
  • ADCC 2026 in Krakow Selling Just 4 Tickets per Day at 15,000-Seat Venue
    With Gordon Ryan absent and multiple high-profile stars out, ticket sales for September's ADCC World Championship at the 15,030-seat Tauron Arena Kraków are averaging only ~4 per day; analysts cite weak main-event appeal (Simoes vs. Duarte superfight), steep pricing relative to Polish wages, and the Michell controversy as compounding factors.
    Source: BJJ World

Global & European Soccer

  • Spain 1-0 Portugal: Merino Header Ends Ronaldo's World Cup in Dallas
    Mikel Merino came off the bench to head in a stoppage-time winner at AT&T Stadium, eliminating Portugal and likely ending Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup career at age 41; Spain advances to the quarterfinals to face Belgium on July 10 in Los Angeles.
    Source: Al Jazeera
  • Belgium 4-1 USA: De Ketelaere Brace Ends Host Nation's World Cup Dream in Seattle
    Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and set up another as Belgium dominated the USMNT 4-1, with Romelu Lukaku adding a stoppage-time fourth; Belgium meets Spain in the quarterfinals on July 10 in Los Angeles.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • World Cup QF Bracket Confirmed: France-Morocco, Spain-Belgium, Norway-England Headline
    The quarterfinal schedule is set: France vs. Morocco (July 9, Boston), Spain vs. Belgium (July 10, Los Angeles), and Norway vs. England (July 11, Miami); Atlético striker Alexander Sørloth and Norway are in the final eight.
    Source: Al Jazeera
  • Romano Issues 'Here We Go' on Lee Kang-in to Atlético Madrid — Official Announcement Imminent
    Transfer insider Fabrizio Romano confirmed all parties agreed on a €35m plus €5m add-ons deal with a five-year contract, with Lee turning down a Middle East offer to join Atlético; the official club announcement is the only remaining step.
    Source: Seoul Economic Daily

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Dow Hits 53,000 for the First Time; Foxconn Beat Sparks AI Optimism, VTI Reaches ~$372
    U.S. equities opened Q3 strong Monday with the Dow closing above 53,000 for the first time, the S&P 500 up 0.7%, and the Nasdaq up 1.1%, driven by Foxconn's stronger-than-expected quarterly sales; VTI advanced to ~$372, near its 52-week high of $374.70.
    Source: Yahoo Finance
  • Apple and Broadcom Extend Custom Chip Partnership Through 2031; AAPL Climbs to ~$313
    Apple and Broadcom extended their chip supply deal covering custom ASICs, cellular modem components, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth silicon across multiple iPhone generations; AAPL rose ~1% to ~$313 and Broadcom jumped over 3%, removing near-term supply uncertainty heading into July 30 Q3 earnings.
    Source: Yahoo Finance
  • BofA Names Spotify a Top Q3 Pick With $685 Price Target — 41% Upside Implied
    Bank of America analyst Jessica Reif Ehrlich issued a Buy call on Spotify with a $685 price target, citing a compelling product roadmap and new subscription pricing tiers — implying ~41% upside — landing three weeks ahead of the July 29 earnings report.
    Source: CNBC
  • NJ 30-Year Mortgage Rate at 6.03% — Nearly 60 Basis Points Below the National Average
    New Jersey's 30-year fixed purchase rate stands at 6.03% versus the national average of 6.61% as of July 6, with the 15-year fixed at 5.38%; NJ homeowners who financed near the 2023 peak of ~8% have a real refinance window, though those with sub-4% pandemic-era mortgages should stay put.
    Source: Bankrate

NJ Local News

  • State Theatre NJ Free Summer Movies Kicks Off Today With 'A Minecraft Movie' — Two Showings
    The State Theatre's free Tuesday summer series begins today (July 7) in New Brunswick with A Minecraft Movie at 10:30 AM and 6:30 PM; the full July lineup continues with Lilo & Stitch (July 14), Zootopia 2 (July 21), and How to Train Your Dragon (July 28) — all free, with evening shows featuring movie-themed arts and crafts at 5:30 PM.
    Source: BroadwayWorld NJ
  • Vintage Race Cars at NJMP This Weekend — VRG Glasstown Speedfest July 10-12 in Millville
    The Vintage Racer Group debuts at NJ Motorsports Park with a three-day event on the Lightning Circuit in Millville (July 10-12), featuring classic sports racers in nearly 3 hours of track time per day — a rare chance to watch authentic vintage road racing about 90 minutes from Montclair.

    Source: CNN

    The Round of 16 continues today with two marquee clashes: Brazil meet Norway at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford at 4pm ET, and Mexico host England at the historic Estadio Azteca in Mexico City at 8pm ET — the first World Cup match at the Azteca since 1986.

    Atlético head coach Diego Simeone addressed the Julián Álvarez situation publicly for the first time, saying the striker's future 'will be resolved this summer' while keeping him in current plans — the clearest signal yet from the dugout that a departure is probable once the World Cup concludes.

    With all 128 slots confirmed for September's ADCC Worlds in Krakow, the bracket shows historic star-power gaps — defending 66kg champion Diogo Reis joins Mica Galvao (77kg) and Giancarlo Bodoni (88kg) among withdrawals, while neither Kade nor Tye Ruotolo, Nick Rodriguez, nor any current UFC BJJ titleholder will compete.

    The ADCC global qualifier roadshow reaches the Croatia Open today at Kresimir Cosic Sports Hall in Zadar, with athletes competing for spots at September's Krakow World Championship; the Miami-Dade Open on July 11 is the next stop on the buildup schedule.
    Source: ADCC Combat

    With three defending champions and the Ruotolo twins absent from Krakow's 128-person bracket, the Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes superfight for Gordon Ryan's vacated title has become the clearest marquee contest — and the match most likely to define who rules the super-heavyweight division for the next era.
    Source: ADCC Combat

Global & European Soccer

  • Argentina Survive World Cup Scare, Beat Cape Verde 3–2 AET: Messi Scores as Islanders Equalize Twice
    Argentina survived their most dramatic World Cup test in years on July 3, winning 3-2 in extra time after Cape Verde equalized twice; Messi and Lautaro Martinez scored for Argentina, but Lopes Cabral's stunning long-range curler deep in extra time was only canceled by a last-gasp Diney Borges own goal.
    Source: Al Jazeera
  • World Cup R16 Double-Header Today: Canada vs. Morocco in Houston (1pm ET), France vs. Paraguay in Philadelphia (5pm ET)
    The 2026 World Cup Round of 16 opens with two July 4th games: Canada faces Morocco at NRG Stadium in Houston, and France — led by Mbappé's record six knockout-stage goals — takes on tournament upset-specialists Paraguay at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.
    Source: Al Jazeera

    Atlético Madrid's official announcement of Lee Kang-in's signing from PSG (≈€30M, 5-year deal) is expected within days, making him the club's first Asian player; separately, Barcelona president Laporta confirmed the €100M bid for Julián Álvarez remains on the table while Atlético holds firm at €150M.
    Source: Football Transfers

Financial Freedom & Markets

    Apple shares surged 4.84% on July 3 to close at $308.63 — the stock’s best single-day gain of 2026 — after reports Apple targets 10 million units of a foldable ‘iPhone Ultra’ (~$2,500) and disclosed a new Google Cloud AI partnership; Q3 earnings on July 30 are the next major test.

    Mikel Oyarzabal scored twice and Pedro Porro added a header as Spain dominated Austria 3-0 on July 2 — their first World Cup knockout-stage win since 2010 — setting up an all-Iberian Round of 16 clash with Portugal on July 7.
    Source: NBC News

    PSG midfielder Lee Kang-in has agreed personal terms on a contract through 2031 with Atlético Madrid at a base transfer fee of approximately €30 million, with an official announcement expected within days as PSG finalizes its two replacements.
    Source: Star News Korea
  • Grimaldo Breaks Silence After Completing Atlético Move: 'My First Choice Was Always Atlético'
    New Atlético signing Alejandro Grimaldo gave his first public comments after completing his move from Bayer Leverkusen, saying the club was his preferred destination all summer and issuing a competitive warning to La Liga and Champions League rivals.
    Source: Tribuna.com

    FC Barcelona president Joan Laporta publicly declared the club has a moral obligation to sign Julián Álvarez, with player-club personal terms already agreed; Barcelona plans to make a formal ~€130M offer to Atlético after the World Cup, while Atlético is holding firm at €150M cash with no installments.

Financial Freedom & Markets

    AAPL rebounded sharply on July 2, rising 4.8% as the soft jobs report lifted the Dow; the stock's next major test is July 30 Q3 earnings, where Apple has guided 14–17% revenue growth and investors will scrutinize the newly announced Google Gemini AI integration and progress on the memory chip shortage.

    Spain — with newly signed Alejandro Grimaldo on the squad — face Austria this afternoon (July 2) at 3pm ET at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood in the World Cup Round of 32; a win puts them on a collision course with Portugal, who also play Croatia tonight at 7pm ET in Toronto.

    Source: NJ Family
  • Montclair Flea Open This Holiday Weekend at Lackawanna Plaza — Saturday and Sunday
    The Montclair Flea returns to 1 Lackawanna Plaza on Saturday July 4 and Sunday July 5 (11am-5pm both days), with curated art, vintage goods, and food — a rain-or-shine family-friendly option in downtown Montclair that complements the morning parade and gives something to do before heading to evening fireworks.
    Source: Lackawanna Station
  • Vintage Racer Group Weekend at NJ Motorsports Park July 10-12 — One Week Away
    Classic and vintage car racing arrives at NJ Motorsports Park in Millville next Thursday through Saturday (July 10-12) with the Vintage Racer Group, featuring road and sidecar racing on Thunderbolt Raceway — just ahead of the New Jersey Lottery SpeedTour bringing F4 U.S. and Formula Americas open-wheel racing July 31-August 2.
    Source: NJ Motorsports Park
