item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ADCC 2026 Roster Takes Twin Hits as Mica Galvao and Giancarlo Bodoni Both Withdraw
    Mica Galvao has withdrawn from ADCC 2026 in Krakow following the arrest of Melqui Galvao, while Giancarlo Bodoni is also out after undergoing two surgeries earlier this year — the most significant dual roster setback to hit the September event since invitations went out.
    Source: BJJ Doc
  • Gracie Barra Wins Team Title at IBJJF American Nationals; Grand Slam Contenders Clay, Hopstock, Jaworski Take Gold Again
    Gracie Barra claimed the overall team title at the IBJJF American Nationals (June 25–27, Las Vegas), while Grand Slam frontrunners Elisabeth Clay, Tarik Hopstock, and Pawel Jaworski all won gold again to stay on course for the No-Gi Grand Slam crown.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • Polaris Announces First-Ever Mainland Europe Events: Open Spain in Barcelona and Open Netherlands in Utrecht
    Polaris is expanding beyond the UK for the first time, debuting Polaris Open Spain in Barcelona on August 29 followed by Polaris Open Netherlands in Utrecht on October 24 — opening the promotion's open-tournament circuit to continental European competitors and fans.
    Source: Polaris Pro Grappling
  • Jacob Rodriguez to End 17-Month Hiatus at Pit Submission Series July 24
    Former ADCC silver medalist Jacob Rodriguez is returning to professional grappling competition on July 24 at the Pit Submission Series, ending an absence of more than 17 months since his last match.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe

Global & European Soccer

  • Mbappé Brace Destroys Sweden 3-0 at MetLife, Sets All-Time World Cup Knockout Goals Record
    Kylian Mbappé scored in the 45th and 74th minutes and Bradley Barcola added a third as France cruised past Sweden 3-0 at MetLife Stadium on June 30; Mbappé's 6-goal tournament total sets the all-time World Cup knockout stage scoring record and France advance to face Paraguay in the Round of 16.
    Source: ESPN
  • Haaland's 86th-Minute Goal Gives Norway Historic First-Ever World Cup Knockout Win Over Ivory Coast
    Erling Haaland netted in the 86th minute to give Norway a dramatic 2-1 win over Ivory Coast in the Round of 32 on June 30 — Norway's first-ever victory in a World Cup knockout match — sending them through to the Round of 16.
    Source: FIFA
  • Atlético Files FIFA Complaint Against Barcelona and Also Rejects Real Madrid's €150M Álvarez Bid
    Atlético CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín formally lodged a FIFA and RFEF complaint accusing Barcelona of illegally approaching Julián Álvarez; separately, Atlético also rejected a €150M bid from Real Madrid for the striker, publicly mocking both clubs, even as Barcelona prepares a revised offer of up to €135–150M.
    Source: ESPN
  • Lee Kang-in Agrees Personal Terms With Atlético Madrid on Deal Through 2031
    Lee Kang-in has agreed personal terms with Atlético Madrid on a contract through 2031 for a fee of approximately €35M, with his PSG exit now confirmed; if completed, he would become the first Asian player ever to represent Atlético.
    Source: Yahoo Sports

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • U.S. Futures Dip at Q3's Open as Wall Street Digests Blockbuster 9.6% First-Half S&P Gain
    Index futures opened Q3 in the red on July 1 — S&P 500 futures off ~0.3% — as investors paused after the S&P's 9.6% H1 gain and Nasdaq's 12.8% surge; key ADP June jobs data and ISM Manufacturing PMI were due to set the tone for VTI and U.S. equity ETFs entering the holiday-shortened week.
    Source: CNBC
  • Apple Confirms July 30 Earnings Date; Wall Street Models $1.89 EPS and 14–17% Revenue Growth
    Apple set its fiscal Q3 2026 earnings call for July 30 after the close, with the Street expecting $1.89 EPS and ~$110.8B in revenue following last quarter's $111.2B (+17% YoY); Wedbush holds a $400 price target and 28 of 47 analysts rate the stock a Buy at an average target near $315.
    Source: Chartmill
  • Spotify Audiobooks+ Hits $100M ARR Milestone Just Ahead of July 29 Earnings
    Spotify's Audiobooks+ add-on is reaching $100M in annualized recurring revenue in July 2026 — up from near-zero two years ago with 1 million subscribers — as the market awaits Q2 2026 earnings on July 29, when analysts will scrutinize whether higher AI compute spending is resolving into margin expansion.
    Source: Publishers Weekly
  • NJ Stay NJ Senior Property Tax Credit Sends Second Quarterly Checks This Month; Mortgage Rates Near 6.27%
    New Jersey's Stay NJ program — which rebates 50% of property taxes (up to $6,500) for eligible homeowners 65+ — begins its second quarterly installment this month alongside Senior Freeze payments starting July 15; NJ 30-year purchase mortgage rates are sitting near 6.27% APR as Q3 opens.
    Source: NJ Spotlight News

NJ Local News

  • Count Basie Orchestra Opens Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series Tonight at Lackawanna Station
    The Legendary Count Basie Orchestra under guest conductor John Faddis kicks off the 2026 Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series tonight at Lackawanna Station — with the Alvin Ailey Dance Company joining in honor of America's 250th — building to the August 15 Downtown Jamboree with Dianne Reeves and Christian McBride.
    Source: Jazz House Kids
  • Brookdale Park Free 'Music Through the Decades' Concert and Fireworks Happening Tonight
    Essex County's free summer concert featuring Van Martin, The Discoteks, and The Empire begins at 7 p.m. tonight at Brookdale Park's Watchung Avenue meadow, with a fireworks spectacular to follow — no tickets needed, bring a blanket.
    Source: Patch
  • Montclair State University Officially Takes Over NJ PBS Today
    As of July 1, Montclair State University's College of Communication and Media assumes management of New Jersey's four public TV stations, returning control to a NJ institution for the first time since 2011 and launching a nightly NJ-centric newscast and at least 6 hours of local programming per week.
    Source: Montclair Local
  • Montclair's July 4th Parade, Picnic, and Fireworks at Yogi Berra Stadium This Saturday
    This Saturday's annual Montclair Independence Day celebration features an 11 a.m. parade down Bloomfield Avenue and Valley Road to Edgemont Park, a family picnic, and an evening fireworks show at Yogi Berra Stadium on the Montclair State campus — all free and a short drive from anywhere in town.
    Source: Township of Montclair

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Clay, Hopstock, and Jaworski All Win Gold at No-Gi Brasileiros, Keeping Grand Slam Bids Alive
    The CBJJ No-Gi Brasileiros (June 27–28), streaming live on FloGrappling for the first time, saw defending world champions Elisabeth Clay, Tarik Hopstock, and Pawel Jaworski all win gold to stay on track for the 2025–26 No-Gi Grand Slam, with Clay and Jaworski also claiming the open-class titles.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • ADCC Amateur World Championship to Debut Alongside Main Event in Krakow This September
    For the first time, the ADCC Amateur World Championship will run concurrently with the main ADCC Worlds at Tauron Arena in Krakow, Poland on September 12–13, giving up-and-coming competitors a chance to perform on the same stage as the sport's elite.
    Source: ADCC Combat
  • Grappling Calendar Turns to IBJJF American Nationals and Polaris 33 After No-Gi Brasileiros
    With No-Gi Brasileiros wrapped up and the Polaris 33 bracket now released, the summer grappling schedule shifts to the IBJJF American Nationals as athletes build final ADCC Worlds preparation ahead of the Krakow event in September.
    Source: FloGrappling

Global & European Soccer

  • Barcelona's €100M Álvarez Bid Rejected; Clubs Meet as Atlético Privately Concedes Exit Is Near
    Atlético turned down Barcelona's initial €100M bid for Julián Álvarez and are holding firm at €150M, but direct club-to-club meetings are now confirmed; Atlético privately concede the departure is near-inevitable after Simeone reportedly lost patience following the player's public transfer request.
    Source: World Soccer Talk
  • World Cup R32: Germany Out on Penalties to Paraguay, Morocco Shocks Netherlands — France Faces Sweden Tonight at MetLife
    Paraguay pulled off a massive Round of 32 upset, beating Germany 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw, while Morocco similarly shocked the Netherlands 3–2 in a shootout; France plays Sweden tonight (June 30) at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford at 5pm ET.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • Goretzka Officially a Free Agent Today; Atlético Mulls Bid but Wage Demands Likely a Dealbreaker
    Leon Goretzka's Bayern Munich contract expired June 30, making him a free agent with Atlético Madrid among interested clubs; however, his ~€15M/year salary demands are beyond what Atlético can accommodate, with Sporting's Morten Hjulmand remaining the club's top midfield target.
    Source: TribalFootball

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • S&P 500 Closes Q2 at 7,436, Up ~9% YTD as VTI Posts 8.6% First-Half Gain
    The S&P 500 ended Q2 2026 at approximately 7,436 — up about 9% year-to-date and only 3% off all-time highs despite a rough June; VTI gained roughly 8.6% in H1 with a 12-month total return near 32%, rewarding long-term index investors who held through the tech selloff.
    Source: Yahoo Finance
  • AAPL Closes Q2 at $282 as Analysts Project Record iPhone and Mac Market Share in H2 2026
    Apple ended the quarter near $282 with a Buy consensus (avg. target $315); Counterpoint Research forecasts iPhone's global market share rising to 25% and Mac to 12% by year-end, suggesting demand remains resilient despite recent device price hikes driven by memory shortages.
    Source: GuruFocus
  • SPOT Down 43% YTD Entering Q3, but 778M MAU Guidance and July 29 Earnings Could Flip Sentiment
    Spotify shares remain deeply in the red for 2026, but Q2 guidance targets 778M monthly active users and €4.8B in revenue (+15% y/y) with gross margin near 33.1%; with 34+ analysts maintaining buy ratings and earnings due July 29 before market open, the report is the next major inflection point.
    Source: MarketBeat

NJ Local News

  • Free Concert and Fireworks at Brookdale Park Tomorrow, July 1 — All Ages Welcome
    Essex County's free Summer Concert Series kicks off July 1 at 7pm at Brookdale Park (Watchung Ave, Bloomfield) with "Music Through the Decades" — Van Martin, The Discoteks, and The Empire — followed by a fireworks spectacular; bring a blanket and enjoy the show at no cost.
    Source: Essex County Parks
  • Free Outdoor Screening of 'Love, Simon' in Montclair This Wednesday, July 1
    A free outdoor showing of "Love, Simon" (2018, PG-13) is scheduled for July 1 at 50 South Fullerton Ave in Montclair — a family-friendly pre-holiday film night ideal for tweens and teens.
    Source: Patch Montclair
  • World Cup Knockout Week at MetLife: France Tonight, Spain July 2, Argentina July 3
    Families near Montclair can catch back-to-back World Cup knockout matches at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford: France vs. Sweden tonight (June 30, 5pm ET), Spain vs. Austria on July 2, and Argentina vs. Cape Verde on July 3 — all within a 30-minute drive.
    Source: NBC Sports

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Owen Jones Docked 30% of Purse After Missing Weight Before Andrey Upset
    At the ONE Fight Night 44 weigh-ins, Owen Jones came in over the featherweight grappling limit, forcing a catchweight bout and a 30% purse forfeiture before he went on to beat Fabricio Andrey by split decision.
    Source: Combat Press
  • UFC's Valter Walker Says He's Abandoning Heel Hooks for Striking
    UFC heavyweight and feared leg-lock specialist Valter Walker says he has dropped jiu-jitsu and wrestling from his training entirely ahead of his July 25 Abu Dhabi bout, opting to trade strikes instead, with one exception if he ever fights Josh Barnett.
    Source: BJJDOC
  • Team North America Edges Europe 5-4 in Polaris' First-Ever Women's Squads Event
    Polaris 32 made history June 28 with the promotion's first all-female Squads showdown at Swansea Arena, with Brianna Ste-Marie's back-to-back wins sealing a narrow 5-4 win for North America after Nia Blackman stepped in as a late-replacement captain for Ffion Davies.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe

Global & European Soccer

  • Lee Kang-in's Move to Atlético Madrid Enters Final Stage as PSG Lines Up Replacement
    Atlético and PSG are closing in on a deal for Lee Kang-in worth roughly €30-35M, with PSG now arranging personal terms with Monaco's Maghnes Akliouche as his direct replacement, a clear sign the transfer fee is largely settled.
    Source: Get French Football News
  • Atlético Madrid Enters Race for Udinese Defender Oumar Solet, Threatening to Gazump Inter Milan
    Atlético are preparing a roughly €25M bid for Udinese centre-back Oumar Solet, jumping ahead of Inter Milan, whose lower offer has stalled while the Serie A club waits on outgoing sales to fund the move.
    Source: Sportingpedia

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Alphabet Officially Joins the Dow, Ending Verizon's 22-Year Run
    Alphabet (GOOGL) replaced Verizon in the Dow Jones Industrial Average effective June 29, joining Nvidia, Amazon, Apple and Microsoft and pushing the price-weighted index's tilt further toward AI and cloud computing.
    Source: CNBC
  • Oil Prices Climb as US-Iran Strikes Cloud Hopes for Reopened Hormuz Shipping
    Brent crude rose about 0.9% Monday after weekend US-Iran strikes renewed doubts about a return to normal shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, even as both sides agreed to resume ceasefire talks in Doha.
    Source: Al Jazeera
  • NJ Homeowners Insurance Premiums Climbed 7.5% Last Year, Outpacing Pennsylvania
    New Jersey home insurance rates rose 7.5% over the past year versus just 1% in Pennsylvania, driven by more frequent severe weather and rising labor and materials costs, though NJ's average premium ($1,449) still trails the $2,395 national average.
    Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer

NJ Local News

  • World Cup Fever Hits Montclair as National Teams Check Into MC Hotel
    The MC Hotel on Bloomfield Avenue has become an unofficial World Cup basecamp, with Germany's team spotted there and England fans waiting over an hour for their team's bus to arrive as squads use Montclair as a stopover for matches at MetLife Stadium.
    Source: Montclair Local
  • Vegan Bakery Yellow Rose Opens Second Location in Montclair's Lackawanna Plaza
    Yellow Rose Vegan Bakery & Cafe, the all-vegan, kosher bakery known for its original Maplewood shop, has opened a new outpost inside Lackawanna Plaza at 1 Lackawanna Plaza in Montclair.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Formula Race Cars Return to NJ Motorsports Park for SpeedTour Weekend
    The New Jersey Lottery SpeedTour with SVRA brings F4 U.S. and FR Americas open-wheel racing back to NJ Motorsports Park in Millville July 31-August 2, part of a packed 2026 season that also includes monster trucks.
    Source: SNJ Today
  • Montclair Pride Festival Postponed a Second Time, Now Set for October 11
    Out Montclair pushed the 2026 Pride Festival back again, from its planned August 1 date to October 11, citing rising production costs and a sharp drop in corporate sponsorship after losing its presenting sponsor.
    Source: Montclair Local
